comment: Datum-frame predicates written by QA from INTAKE_CARD.md §4 (functional zones Z1-Z4, band = regime p95/max per the intake table; interface_max is null in this regime, so they are gated as kind 'whole' at the regime band) and from QA's own x-z projection of the aligned scan (qa/_work/scan_xz_yz.png) for the box limits.

zones.name: Z1 rod spigot taper + O-ring seats

zones.name: Z2 steel tube B-bend-C

zones.name: Z4 bushing + tip
